'''1999 Naboo Regionals''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament for the Naboo region (UK and Ireland), played on 12 September 1999. Latham's results page calls it Regional Final '99.<ref name="tourneys">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm My Tournament Reports], Rod Latham, [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001204191500/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="lst13">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/lst13.htm Toys And Mains], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319195328/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/lst13.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dst13">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/dst13.htm Ralltiir Universal (Sept 1999)], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319183217/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/dst13.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Qualified for Worlds:''' [[Gary Carman]] (Decipher's 1999 finalists list)<ref name="field99">[https://web.archive.org/web/19991128125001/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/finalists.html Finalists], Decipher (Wayback 28 November 1999)</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 12 September 1999
* '''Site:''' United Kingdom; Sheraton hotel, England<ref name="tr-d38" />; Birmingham, England<ref name="tr-d860">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-09-naboo-regional-2000-into-the-fired860/ naboo-regional-2000-into-the-fire], DeckTech (Alex "Greedo" Tennet, 9 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-09-naboo-regional-2000-into-the-fired860/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
* '''Winner:''' Unknown

== Dating ==

Latham's tournament decks are dated 12 September 1999 and their records add up to 3–3, matching "Regional Final '99" on his results page. Latham lived in the Naboo region, so this is that region's 1999 final.
